name: graveyard
description: The Graveyard (graveyard, graveyard_2), rebuilt from scratch for ROADMAP 49 (tools/blueprints/briefs/graveyard.md, REBUILD.md): the Lantern Yard. MC_BUILDER = the minecraft-builder skill's folder. Until the critic says SHIP, 'build' writes candidates.

scripts.build: node "$MC_BUILDER/scripts/run-build.mjs" recipe.mjs --out-dir out --data-version 3955 && python3 ../../rebuild.py graveyard graveyard --candidate --nbt out/graveyard.nbt && LEVEL=2 node "$MC_BUILDER/scripts/run-build.mjs" recipe.mjs --out-dir out --data-version 3955 && python3 ../../rebuild.py graveyard graveyard_2 --candidate --nbt out/graveyard-2.nbt
